stem.text: A uniform rectangular board is supported by a frictionless pivot at its centre point P.

stem.alt: Rectangular board with corners labelled Q (lower left) and R (upper right); a point P at the centre; a dimension of 20 cm between the left edge line and P; force F shown downward at Q and force 2.5F shown to the right at R.

stem.text: Two forces act in the plane of the board. Force $F$ acts at corner Q and force $2.5F$ acts at corner R. The perpendicular distance between the line of action of force $F$ and point P is $20\,\text{cm}$. The board is in equilibrium.
What is the area of the board?
